EngiWorld Tasks
	

This repository contains the 1,301 tasks for EngiWorld, covering 26 engineering software platforms across six domains. It provides task definitions, evaluators, and the complete task input and reference resources, including the original engineering drawings and binary project files.

Paper: Read the paper
Project website: engiworld.github.io
